claims.text: Very high-risk ASCVD on max tolerated statin: add ezetimibe and/or a PCSK9 mAb
claims.quote: In adults with clinical ASCVD who are at very high risk and on maximally tolerated statin therapy, ezetimibe and/or a PCSK9 mAb should be added
to achieve a goal of LDL-C <55 mg/dL

claims.text: Inclisiran = reasonable if unable to tolerate or obtain evolocumab or alirocumab, or w a strong preference for less freq dosing.
claims.quote: it is reasonable to add inclisiran in those unable to tolerate or obtain evolocumab or alirocumab or have a strong preference for less frequent dosing
